implementation_summary.what_was_wired: Promptset section validation from v4 (validate_promptset_sections, _iter_promptset_prompt_files, exception class) into v5 preflight (_validate_promptset_sections_preflight called at main() startup)
implementation_summary.where: run_extraction_v5.py lines 38 (yaml import), 56 (validate_rendered_prompt import), 13418-13533 (validation functions), 21182-21183 (preflight call in main())
implementation_summary.how_it_works: At v5 startup, _validate_promptset_sections_preflight() loads promptset.yaml, calls _validate_promptset_sections() with skip_missing_files=True, raises PromptSectionContractError if any available prompt is missing required sections
implementation_summary.key_design_decision: Skip missing prompt files during preflight (they'll be caught as blocked promptset later), but enforce section contract on all available prompts. This allows the test for missing sections to work while not interfering with the blocked promptset flow.
implementation_summary.test_coverage: Added test_v5_canonical_entrypoint_rejects_missing_sections that directly tests v5's validation function with a broken promptset
